environment.rtl: offscreen structure passed; live shell mirroring blocked

automatedEvidence.observation: The full release gate, sanitizers, accessibility review and Phase 0 performance comparison passed.

liveCases.observation: The Global Theme applied in a separate KWin/Plasma Wayland session without changing the maintainer desktop.
The isolated panel configuration hash and panel count were identical before and after theme application.
The live isolated panel rendered at bottom, top, left and right without a visible seam.
Solid and translucent assets pass, but the virtual framebuffer cannot prove blur quality.
liveCases.blocker: No isolated hardware-composited blur output is available.

liveCases.observation: Real System Settings processes were composed by KWin at scale 1.0 and 1.4.
Keyboard structure and focus rendering pass automated checks; full live traversal was not exercised.
liveCases.blocker: The isolated compositor has no keyboard input injector.

liveCases.observation: RTL geometry passes authentic offscreen renders, but live Plasma mirroring was not proven.
liveCases.blocker: The isolated Plasma shell did not provide a trustworthy live RTL result.

liveCases.observation: The isolated desktop, panel, wallpaper and required shell icons rendered without visible missing artwork.
Aurorae composed live and its sprites validate structurally, but the complete interactive state sequence was not exercised.
liveCases.blocker: Pointer injection is unavailable for hover, pressed, inactive and maximized transitions.

liveCases.observation: Long-title live applications opened, but the D-Bus shortcut attempt did not leave a visible switcher capture.
liveCases.blocker: A held Alt+Tab cycle and empty-state transition cannot be injected into the isolated compositor.

liveCases.observation: Required panel icons remained distinct and legible on horizontal and vertical live panels.
Physical cursor sizes and animation frames validate, but live motion and scale transitions were not exercised.
liveCases.blocker: The virtual compositor exposes no controllable pointer for live scale captures.

liveCases.observation: Sound sources pass normalization and semantic checks, but no isolated physical route was qualified.
liveCases.blocker: The isolated runtime has no independently qualified PipeWire speaker or headphone route.

liveCases.observation: The real logout greeter and inherited lock screen rendered; the splash test runner showed only its generic test presentation.
liveCases.blocker: The isolated runner did not prove the v5 splash through its production login integration.

liveCases.observation: KWin composed two independent 1280 by 720 outputs without panel or wallpaper placement failure.
The real SDDM greeter rendered NoxForge in test mode with user, session, input and power surfaces.
liveCases.blocker: Test mode cannot prove PAM authentication or real power actions, and the maintainer login screen was not changed.
